title: Pearl S. Buck: The First American Woman to Win a Nobel Prize in Literature
summary: Нобелийн шагнал хүртсэн анхны америк эмэгтэй зохиолч Перл Бакийн амьдрал.

source.name: VOA Learning English
source.credit: Jim Tedder, John Russell · VOA Learning English

questions.prompt: Where did Pearl Buck live for nearly 40 years?
questions.explain: Текстэд "For nearly 40 years, China was her home" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: What is The Good Earth about?
options: A poor Chinese farmer and his wife
A rich American family in China
questions.explain: "The Good Earth is the story of a poor Chinese man named Wang Lung" гэж бичсэн. Тэр эхнэр О-Лантайгаа хамт газар авч тариалан эрхэлдэг.
"In 1938, Buck became the first American woman to be awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature" гэж бичсэн. Пулитцерийн шагналыг түүнээс өмнө, 1932 онд авсан.
